## Core Services

### 1. Custom ERP & Wholesale Inventory Management Systems
- Real-time multi-branch inventory tracking with batch & serial number management.
- Supplier purchase order automation, landed cost calculation, and goods received note (GRN) workflows.
- Customer ledger, debit/credit accounts receivable, aging reports, and cash flow reconciliation.
- Automated low-stock alerts, stock transfer requests, and multi-warehouse logistics.
- Role-based access control (RBAC) with granular security permissions and audit trails.

### 2. Offline-First Mobile POS (Point of Sale)
- Seamless billing and invoicing for iOS, Android, and Desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux).
- True offline capability: full billing, barcode scanning, and receipt printing even during internet outages using local IndexedDB/SQLite storage.
- Auto-reconciliation background sync as soon as network connectivity is restored.
- Hardware integrations: ESC/POS thermal receipt printers (Bluetooth, USB, Network), barcode/2D QR scanners, electronic cash drawers, and customer-facing displays.

### 3. Mobile Parts & Electronics Industry Solutions
- Specialized classification for mobile screens, IC chips, flex cables, housing, and battery models with brand/generation compatibility matrix.
- IMEI / Serial tracking for repair jobs, warranty tracking, and technician performance metrics.
- Wholesale tiered pricing models (Retail, B2B wholesale, VIP partner pricing).

### 4. High-Performance Headless E-Commerce & Web Platforms
- Next.js / React / Vite frontends with ultra-fast Core Web Vitals (< 1s LCP, 100/100 performance scores).
- Firebase, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and GraphQL serverless backends.
- Custom payment gateway integration, SMS notification hooks, and WhatsApp order dispatch bots.

---

## Technical Stack & Architecture

- **Frontend:** React 19, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP.
- **Backend & Cloud:** Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Auth, Storage), Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, REST & GraphQL APIs.
- **Offline Storage & Workers:** IndexedDB, SQLite, Service Workers, Background Sync API.
- **Hardware Bridging:** WebUSB, Web Bluetooth, ESC/POS Raw Socket TCP, Serial COM ports.
- **Security:** Enterprise RBAC, end-to-end encrypted payloads, audit log streams, automated daily cloud backups.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What services does M-Tech Solutions provide?
M-Tech Solutions provides end-to-end custom software engineering, specializing in Custom ERP & Inventory Management, Offline-First Mobile POS systems, Mobile Parts Wholesale Platforms, and High-Performance Web Applications.

### How do offline POS systems handle internet outages?
Our POS applications store transactions locally in secure offline storage (IndexedDB/SQLite). Invoicing, printing, and scanning continue with zero interruption. When connectivity returns, transactions automatically reconcile with the cloud database.

### Can M-Tech Solutions integrate with existing hardware?
Yes. We integrate with ESC/POS thermal receipt printers, USB/Bluetooth barcode scanners, cash drawers, and barcode label printers without requiring you to replace your existing physical hardware.

### What is the typical project delivery timeline?
Custom systems are typically delivered in 2 to 6 weeks depending on project scope, with agile milestone releases and live staging previews.
